name: wall-thickness-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for `wallThickness` (simple tier): the plan-wide 'Wall thickness' Exterior/Interior Num fields in the no-selection PlanInspector default panel, plus the per-wall 'Use plan default' override in WallInspector. Drives the plan-wide Exterior field via a real native input event and asserts `floorPlan.wallThickness.external` updates; selects a wall, sets its own thicknessM override, asserts `wall.thicknessM` is set and the 'Use plan default' button appears, clicks it, and asserts the override clears back to the plan default. Re-verifies both panels are present after a Simple→Pro switch (wallThickness is simple-tier, shown in both modes).

steps.name: verify-wallthickness-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: wallThickness should be ON in Simple mode (it is simple-tier)

steps.name: plan-props-visible
steps.failMessage: The no-selection PlanInspector default panel (.plan-props) did not render

steps.name: wall-thickness-fields-visible
steps.eval: (function(){ const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-props label')]; const ext = labels.find((l)=>l.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim()==='Exterior (m)'); const inter = labels.find((l)=>l.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim()==='Interior (m)'); if (!ext || !inter) throw new Error('Wall thickness Exterior/Interior fields did not render in the plan defaults panel'); })()

steps.name: set-exterior-thickness
steps.eval: (function(){ const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-props label')]; const ext = labels.find((l)=>l.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim()==='Exterior (m)'); const input = ext.querySelector('input'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(input, '0.3'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: exterior-thickness-updated
steps.failMessage: floorPlan.wallThickness.external should be 0.3 after editing the Exterior field

steps.name: select-a-wall
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const w=s.floorPlan.walls[0]; window.__wallId = w.id; s.setPlanSelection({ type:'wall', id: w.id }); })()

steps.name: wall-thickness-override-field-visible
steps.eval: (function(){ const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-props label')]; const t = labels.find((l)=>l.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim()==='Thickness (m)'); if (!t) throw new Error("Per-wall 'Thickness (m)' field did not render in WallInspector"); })()

steps.name: set-wall-override
steps.eval: (function(){ const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-props label')]; const t = labels.find((l)=>l.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim()==='Thickness (m)'); const input = t.querySelector('input'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(input, '0.45'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: wall-override-stored
steps.failMessage: wall.thicknessM should be 0.45 after editing the per-wall Thickness field

steps.name: click-use-plan-default
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-props button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Use plan default'); if (!btn) throw new Error("'Use plan default' button not found after setting a wall override"); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wall-override-cleared
steps.failMessage: wall.thicknessM should be cleared after clicking 'Use plan default'

steps.name: verify-wallthickness-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: wallThickness should still be ON in Pro mode (simple-tier flags are shown in both modes)

steps.name: wall-thickness-field-still-present-in-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-props label')]; const t = labels.find((l)=>l.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim()==='Thickness (m)'); if (!t) throw new Error("Per-wall 'Thickness (m)' field should still render in Pro mode"); })()
